excerpts.text:
The Americas was the largest segment in fiscal 2025, at $178.4 billion in net sales; Europe reported $111.0 billion, and Greater China $64.4 billion.

Greater China sales declined, Apple said, primarily because of lower iPhone sales, partly offset by higher Mac sales. The Americas, Europe, Japan, and Rest of Asia Pacific increased, with iPhone and Services contributing to several regions’ growth.
